adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a transactional consistency issue. Looking at the diff in addGuests.handler.ts, the code first updates the database at line 92 with `prisma.booking.update()` to add guests, then later calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` at line 161. If the calendar update fails, the database already has the guests committed. The `uniqueGuests` filter at lines 68-72 checks `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`, so on retry, those guests would be filtered out as duplicates, preventing repair of the external calendar. This is a real consistency bug where partial failure leaves the system in an inconsistent state.
